purpose: the 1024² run the ERNIE-Image memory constants were calibrated on (mlx_dfloat.mflux.ernie.memory); one record per CFG batch size
prompt: A stone lighthouse on a rocky shore at dawn, waves breaking below it and a small fishing boat far out on the water
footprint_peaks_label: OS phys_footprint in bytes, the peak of each phase; for the MEASURED and identity runs the run's watched peak, reached in the VAE phase
sizes_label: FamilySizes as mlx_dfloat.mflux.ernie.memory.sizes_for computes them: encoders is the language model's evaluated layers (its last layer never runs), not the 6_858_012_672 B of every language-model tensor
